h: Human Effort and Divine Gifts in Shabbos Meals

And here it uses the expression
and it is not written "I will delight you,"

So too, "and I will feed you
the inheritance of Yaakov your father"
is also in the expression "and I will feed you,"
for it is from Hashem Yisbarach;
for this too the Jew recognizes,
that it is from Hashem Yisbarach,
since he merits the inheritance of Yaakov.
וְיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם אָמַר (בְּרֵאשִׁית מח, טו)
And Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom, said (Bereishis 48:15):
"The God Who shepherds me from my beginning";
that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach.
And so in his prayer he said (ibid. 28:20):
"And He will give me bread to eat";
whereas regarding the convert it says (Devarim 10:18)
that he recognized that Hashem Yisbarach
is also the One Who feeds;

and therefore here too the expression is used,
"and I will feed you the inheritance of Yaakov your father."
